sydney: heads-up — customers reported restore failures for DB snapshots after today's RBAC pruning. Error shows KMS permission denied during DEK unwrap.
eli: paste minimal log
sydney: `2026-04-01T16:02:11Z ERROR restore: decrypt failed rpc PermissionDenied caller lacks cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter; snapshot=db-prod-20260328`
pagerduty-bot: IAM change detected: removed broad role binding from serviceAccount:uploader@redwood-prod at 2026-04-01T15:40:02Z
mira: uploader used to have decrypt via the key's IAM. RBAC PR narrowed storage roles but didn't add equivalent KMS grants.
ops-lee: mitigation options: temp scoped grant, execute restore under backup-decryptor SA, or roll back RBAC PR. Given impact, temp grant is fastest.
sydney: applied temp grant (1h) to cryptoKey:backups/db-key for uploader SA, re-ran restore — success for 2 tenants.
eli: action items — (SEC) inventory pipelines where uploader performs decrypt; (ENG) move decrypt to dedicated decryptor SA; (SRE) add pre-merge kms-iam diff smoke test.
mira: I'll open ENGSEC-4420 with logs and proposed conditional grant pattern. ops-lee: will revoke temp grant after handoff. :thumbsup:
_note: Slack thread stored as a single continuous string with prefixed sender names, per agents.md. No title field included.
